reference: CONTROLLED TEST — not a publication. Synthetic protocol with a deliberate 10x unit error in the shear claim.
paper_claim: Wall shear claimed as 0.5 Pa (a dyne/cm^2 vs Pa mix-up), while the reported 400x100x20 um channel at 2 uL/min actually gives 0.05 Pa.
note: Negative control: the classic unit-conversion error (dyn/cm^2 vs Pa differs by 10x). The verifier recomputes 0.05 Pa from the paper's own inputs and flags the claim.
